headline: Lightning recall Sam O’Reilly from AHL, place Brayden Point on IR
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that the Lightning recalled Sam O'Reilly from the AHL and placed Brayden Point on injured reserve. O'Reilly came to Tampa Bay from Edmonton in 2025 in a one-for-one swap for Isaac Howard.

Point's absence costs TBL its top pivot. He has 16 points in 17 games so far this season, and his own expected goals (the quality of his chances) are 6.63 against 5 actual goals, so his finishing has lagged his looks. The Lightning take 59.89 percent of the expected goals at five-on-five with him on the ice, and their share is 5.63 points better with him than without. The team is 11-4-2 with 55.4 percent of expected goals overall, but its goalies are 2.9 goals below expected, so the cushion is thinner than the record suggests. Going by how the coach has used his players, Brandon Hagel (19:30 a night) is next in line for Point's minutes, and Anthony Cirelli, the busiest man on the second power-play unit, is the likeliest to move up there.
